notes.title: Available Now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206627/d6a5e48b8dd6a69c8aaafc27ed18d710542e9b89.png[/img]

[h1]Available Now[/h1]

[h3]Starting Today[/h3]
This marks a new chapter for me—releasing my game and learning how I can improve, fix, and create even more with Unreal Engine 5, exploring new styles of gameplay. As I always say, I will give my best with Climbing Challenges. The game represents my growth, and with every day or every new level, there are new things to add and learn.
I hope you enjoy the game and its levels! If you find any bugs or issues, please let me know, and I'll fix them as soon as possible.


[h3]Preparation for the Future[/h3]
The next level is still in development, and I already have plans for what's to come. The full release will happen once the story is fully covered, along with key levels, but it won’t be too far off. I just need to finish the script and the essential levels, and then the full release will follow. I'll continue to update the game, adding new levels and learning more along the way.
In the upcoming levels, there will be new ways to overcome these [u]Challenges[/u]. I plan to integrate MetaHumans and explore their animations. I enjoy working and learning through this process, and I hope many people join this journey and love it as much as I do.

:)

notes.title: Script Finalized for Levels 1-4! Ready for October Launch!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206627/55123a0137560e83769d19cfdd923d896e10d8cc.png[/img]

[h1] Update about the Climbing Challenges [/h1]

Here's a brief update on the game's status leading up to the October release: I've completed the storyline for levels 1-4. Currently, I'm addressing any bugs that may exist, adding effects, and other finishing touches—what I refer to as "The Effects."

Regarding the release date, it will not be delayed; I am working diligently to incorporate all the elements that I want to include in the game. Once everything is finalized, I will announce the exact date in October.

This is my first experience with releasing a game, and I'm learning something new every day. I hope you all enjoy it.

I'm telling the story I want to tell, doing my best, and I'll see you all soon.

:)
